title: wt restore <dir> --dry-run --json
description: What `wt restore <dir>` would do, changing nothing. Printed by `wt restore <dir> --dry-run --json` as the only thing on stdout. Schema 1: fields may be added and enumerations may gain values; nothing is renamed or removed. See docs/json.md.

locked.description: The worktree carries this quarantine's git lock, which the restore takes off last.

orphan.description: A worktree locked for this quarantine with no recovery.json: stopped before anything moved; restoring it is unlocking it.

problems.description: Every reason the restore refuses; empty when it would go ahead.

error.description: The problems in words, or why the plan could not be made.

location.description: original: at path, the same directory (by inode) — moved back, or never moved. quarantined: in the quarantine. taken: something else is at path. missing: in neither place.

removal.description: What the removal's branch step came to, as recovery.json records it.

action.description: none: the branch is there at its tip. renameBack: kept under keepAs; gets its name back, config included. recreate: deleted and the name free; made again at tip with its recorded config. attach: its name holds another commit and keepAs still has tip; HEAD names keepAs. detach: another worktree uses it, or it moved on; no branch change, HEAD detached at head. null when a problem stops the decision.

occupiedBy.description: The worktree that has the branch — as HEAD, rebasing it, or bisecting from it — when that made the action detach.
